candidates.changed_node: RANK($earnings_per_share) leg and the /($close+1e-8) ratio normalization (window changed 21->10 to avoid restating existing close-high fragments)
candidates.rationale: RANK(eps)-RANK(X) is a closed template in this archive: 9+ live members share it at rho 0.92-1.00 regardless of X, so keeping bare EPS instead would collide even harder (EPS dominates the difference's variance). Two attempts that kept both legs and only tweaked the ratio were already rejected against this exact parent (rho 0.847 dropping the epsilon guard, rho 0.938 switching to a product), so the fundamental leg has to go entirely. Reusing the full ratio+TS_RANK block verbatim would restate the parent's own subtree, and TS_RANK($close-$high,21) alone already exists inside live member 1c86de87ea22d4b6, so the redundant /(close+eps) scaling is dropped (TS_RANK already makes this a within-name percentile over a short window, where price barely moves) and the window shifts 21->10 to avoid restating either fragment. Sibling 7845cd7221c9ed60 (a close-high-derived factor with no fundamental leg) scores fitness 6.725, next to this parent's 6.901, supporting that the price leg alone carries most of the fit-window IC. Fields 3->2 (drops earnings_per_share), depth reduced by removing both the eps branch and the division layer.

candidates.changed_node: dropped $dollar_volume and the TS_DELTA($volume,3)/(TS_MAX($dollar_volume,21)+1e-8) ratio, replaced with bare CS_RANK($volume)
candidates.rationale: The parent's own lineage shows the TS_DELTA($volume,3)/(TS_MAX($dollar_volume,21)+eps) machinery isn't the load-bearing part: grandparent 6f1e4cb086d0ffb0 (bare CS_RANK(eps)*CS_RANK(TS_MAX(dollar_volume,21)/close)) alone scores mean_ic 0.00911, 89% of this parent's 0.01019, and sibling 30503782276ad883 (CS_RANK(eps)*CS_RANK(TS_CORR(return,volume,21)), a completely different volume statistic) lands in the same 0.009-0.010 band. So CS_RANK(eps) crossed with essentially any volume/liquidity signal reproduces most of the fit. Bare RANK(volume) carries a documented standalone mean IC of ~0.0088, well above the 0.001-0.003 seen from time-series volume percentiles, and no archive member here uses a bare volume rank, so there's no subtree or near-duplicate collision from that leg. Fields 3->2 (drops dollar_volume), depth 5->2, constants unchanged at 0.

prompt:
You are proposing quantitative factor expressions for US large-cap equities.

Universe and data
- S&P 500 point-in-time constituents, roughly 500 names per day.
- Daily bars only, plus point-in-time quarterly fundamentals stamped from the
  report date. Every field is referenced with a leading `$`:
    $open $high $low $close $adj_close $volume $dollar_volume $return
    $roa $roe $operating_margin $leverage $asset_turnover
    $book_per_share $earnings_per_share $accrual_gap
  A bare name such as `close` is not a field and will be rejected.
- Execution convention: the signal is computed after the close of day T and the
  position is entered at the open of T+1.
- The window these factors are fitted and judged on runs from 2000 to 2013.
  Do not reason about anything later; you will never be shown a number from
  outside that window.

Syntax
- Operators are function calls: TS_MEAN, TS_STD, TS_MAX, TS_MIN, TS_RANK,
  TS_DELTA, TS_CORR, TS_COV, TS_SUM, TS_PRODUCT, TS_ARGMAX, TS_ARGMIN,
  TS_DECAY_LINEAR, EMA, DELAY, DELTA, RANK, ZSCORE, CS_RANK, CS_ZSCORE,
  CS_DEMEAN, IF, IF_ELSE, MIN, MAX, ABS, SIGN, LOG, LN, SQRT, POWER, BOUND,
  COUNT.
- Lookback windows must be positive integer literals, e.g. TS_MEAN($close, 21).
- Guard every division with a small epsilon: `/ (TS_STD($close, 21) + 1e-8)`.
- Well-formed example: -RANK(TS_CORR(RANK($close), RANK($volume), 5))

Hard limits every proposal must satisfy, or it is rejected before it is scored
- at most 200 characters
- at most 5 distinct `$fields`
- at most 4 free numeric constants (lookback windows and
  the 1e-8 epsilon guard do not count)
- expression tree depth at most 6
- must not share a complete sub-expression of 4 or more
  nodes with any published Alpha101 formula, or with any factor already in the
  archive. Restating a published alpha is the one thing that is always rejected.
- must cover at least 90% of the panel
- absolute rank correlation below 0.80 against every archive member

Output
- Return valid JSON only, matching the supplied JSON schema. No prose outside it.


TASK: SIMPLIFY. Each expression below was flagged as more complex than it needs
to be. Return a simpler expression that keeps the same idea.

Simpler means strictly fewer distinct fields, fewer free constants, or less
depth. The simplification is accepted only if it also keeps at least
80% of the parent's fit-window |IC|, so do not remove the component
doing the work. Put the parent's id in `parent_ids` and name what you removed in
`changed_node`.
